Lanzarote · 5–10 November 2026

A little more space to breathe.

Five nights of yoga, shared meals and sea air at a villa in northern Lanzarote, hosted by Ricard Chillon.

  • £1,350 per person
  • Five nights
  • Flights not included
Ask Ricard about joining How the days feel

Truly the RR of retreats.

A few days to step away from the everyday: to move, to rest, to eat well and to share the table with good company. Come as you are, and take what you need from each day.

The experience

How the days feel

  1. Morning

    Morning practice

    Start the day with an active yoga class in the studio, with the sea beyond the glass. Classes are beginner-friendly and always optional: join in, take it gently, or sit this one out.

  2. Daytime

    Time to yourself

    Free time to rest or explore at your own pace. Read, walk by the sea, or simply do nothing for a while.

  3. Evening

    Evenings together

    A gentler restorative or yin practice, with breathwork, meditation and relaxing sound, then dinner around a shared table.

Three chef-prepared meals are included every day. Every session is optional and suited to beginners, and mats are available.

Your host

Ricard Chillon

Personal trainer and yoga teacher

Movement, reflection and connection, brought together.

Ricard brings movement, reflection and connection together. He is sincere, empathetic and positive: a thoughtful, proactive host and a natural community builder, who likes people to feel at ease and part of things from the start.

His classes welcome you wherever you are with your practice, and you are welcome to message him with any questions before you decide.

Level 3 personal trainer · 200-hour YMCA yoga teacher training

In their words

The villa

A villa by the sea

A villa in northern Lanzarote, close to the sea and natural pools.

There is a yoga studio looking out to the water, light-filled shared spaces to gather in, and quiet corners for when you would rather be on your own.

Villa access from 16:00 on Thursday 5 November. For directions and room sharing details, just ask Ricard.

Food

Around the table

Three chef-prepared meals, every day.

Meals are cooked for the group by the chef behind @maurosiepechef, together with his wife. They are a chance to slow down, sit together and talk about the day.

The menu is not exclusively vegetarian. Vegetarian or vegan needs and any allergies can be discussed with Ricard before you arrive.

Good to know

I'm new to yoga. Is this for me?

Yes. Classes are beginner-friendly and every session is optional, so you can join in as much or as little as you like.

Coming on your own?

You're welcome. Shared meals and sessions make it easy to feel part of things, at whatever pace suits you.

What about dietary needs and allergies?

The menu is not exclusively vegetarian. Vegetarian or vegan needs and any allergies can be discussed with Ricard before the retreat.

Do I need to bring a yoga mat?

Mats are available at the villa. If you have a mat you love, you're welcome to bring your own.

How do I ask about joining?

Message Ricard on Instagram at @ricardchillonpt or email ricardchillon@gmail.com to ask about availability, rooms, payment or anything else.
